data.desc: SR Bancorp, Inc. is the holding company for Somerset Regal Bank, a full-service New Jersey commercial bank headquartered in Bound Brook, New Jersey that operates 14 branches in Essex, Hunterdon, Middlesex, Morris, Somerset and Union Counties, New Jersey. At March 31, 2026, Somerset Regal Bank had $1.14 billion in total assets, $859.1 million in net loans, $897.6 million in deposits and total equity of $181.3 million. Additional information about Somerset Regal Bank is available on its website, www.somersetregalbank.com.
